requirements.title: Owner private access
requirements.oracle: Unauthenticated users cannot access private pages; the Owner and an isolated acceptance identity can authenticate over real HTTPS without exposing credentials in evidence.

requirements.title: Candidate truth layer
requirements.oracle: High-impact facts originate from Owner input and survive refresh/restart without invented values.

requirements.title: Encrypted candidate data, resume and experience bank
requirements.oracle: Supported resumes are parsed; persistent originals and high-impact candidate fields are encrypted; upload object names are opaque; legacy plaintext is migrated; structured experiences remain user-correctable.

requirements.title: Safe job import
requirements.oracle: Only reviewed public ATS hosts may be read within limits; restricted and arbitrary targets use the manual-JD fallback without becoming a general-purpose fetcher.

requirements.title: Explainable eligibility and fit
requirements.oracle: The deterministic result exposes reasons, risks and unknowns; material eligibility conflicts cannot produce Apply; AI output cannot override this state.

requirements.title: Application pack with manual-submit boundary
requirements.oracle: The user receives a reviewable pack; AI may improve unreviewed prose only; no third-party login or submit action exists; Applied requires evidence.

requirements.title: Progress persistence and readback
requirements.oracle: Application status and evidence survive reload, re-login, process restart and application-container restart on the real HTTPS deployment.

requirements.title: Export, encrypted backup and recovery
requirements.oracle: Canonical JSON contains no candidate private plaintext or provider key; an authenticated Owner can download a readable copy; encrypted recovery packs recreate state in isolation; sync state is honest.

requirements.title: Web security, operations and rollback
requirements.oracle: Security controls, exact runtime dependencies, protected storage verification, container restrictions, health/readiness, full live HTTPS write/read/restart transaction, temporary-probe cleanup, rollback and data recovery are executable.

requirements.title: Zero technical burden
requirements.oracle: A normal user completes the product path in the web UI; the only AI setup action is a one-time key paste and checkbox confirmation.

requirements.title: DeepSeek secure BYOK configuration
requirements.oracle: The key is encrypted at rest, never echoed, excluded from canonical export and logs, and can be tested, disabled and revoked without shell access.

requirements.title: AI privacy, budget and degraded operation
requirements.oracle: Direct identifiers are removed before provider calls; request/token budgets and a circuit breaker are enforced; provider failures preserve deterministic analysis and previously reviewed content.

verdicts.PASS: All applicable core requirements pass on the exact deployment, DeepSeek is ready through a real official API verification, authorized long-term sync is ready, and no P0/P1 remains.
verdicts.CONDITIONAL_PASS: Core product, safety, data and rollback pass; DeepSeek activation or an authorized optional external sync remains explicitly pending.
verdicts.FAIL: The candidate violates an acceptance oracle.
verdicts.BLOCKED: A required domain, production authority or Owner-only governance decision is unavailable.
